tool.name: audit_observe
tool.description: Read authorized documents through the native ABS signed readonly plan interface.
tool.details: Only available to the signed-plan native arms. A single-document interface reads one document per call; a plan interface reads up to its permitted count in one plan. Values returned are the original source values.

parameter.description: JSON array of document IDs from your assigned partition, e.g. ["I1","I2","I3"]. A single mode permits one; plan mode up to three.

returns.description: Per-document facts and opaque receipts, or an error.

tool.name: audit_receive
tool.description: Receive a bounded chunk of original facts and questions.
tool.details: Repeat while the response's remaining_messages is positive. Questions arrive as messages to answer with audit_publish.

returns.description: Received facts and questions, with a remaining count.

tool.name: audit_publish
tool.description: Deliver selected received source facts, or a clarification, to another native role.
tool.details: Refs must be exact fact IDs you actually received; their values stay the original source values. Use the receipts returned by audit_observe.

parameter.description: Target role: inventory, events, requirements or integration.
JSON array of at most 80 exact fact IDs actually received.
JSON array of opaque receipts returned by your document reads; use [] for previously acknowledged evidence.
An optional question, or a concise interpretation of the selected evidence.
Original message ID when answering a question; otherwise omit.

tool.name: audit_submit
tool.description: Submit the joint report for all assigned components to Arena's independent evaluator.

parameter.description: JSON object with findings, unresolved_findings and notes. Each finding includes component, check, classification, assessment_tick and its typed proof.

returns.description: Evaluation result; on pass the agent is marked complete.
